title: Dashboard app
description: Usage, latency and errors of the KernelCI web dashboard backend (dashboard.kernelci.org), from its own metrics

list.name: Deploys
list.expr: max by (version) (dashboard_build_info{job="dashboard_metrics"}) unless max by (version) (dashboard_build_info{job="dashboard_metrics"} offset 5m)

list.name: rate
list.label: Rate window
list.description: Scraped every 5m and traffic is low; 1h gives smooth graphs, 15m shows short spikes

panels.title: Exporter
panels.description: Is the dashboard backend's metrics endpoint (:2001) answering scrapes

panels.title: Unique visitors (last 24h)
panels.description: Distinct visitors (salted and rotated daily, no IPs stored) over the last 24 hours, regardless of the selected range

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Share of API requests answered 4xx or 5xx

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Backend restarts (deploys included) in the selected range

panels.title: Requests by client
panels.description: dashboard = the web UI, kci-dev = the CLI, script = python-requests and similar, unknown = no recognisable user agent

panels.title: Daily unique visitors
panels.description: One bar per UTC day. Series before release/20261008.0 have no client label and show as an unlabelled series

panels.title: Visitors by requests per day
panels.description: How many visitors made 1-5, 6-10, ... requests on each UTC day. 1000+ is almost certainly automation

panels.title: Endpoints (selected time range)
panels.description: Visitors/day = average distinct visitors per UTC day over the range (at least one day). Server time = total seconds spent answering the endpoint, i.e. where the backend's time goes. Latency quantiles are estimated from histogram buckets; the largest finite bucket is 75s, so a p95 of 50-75s means 'at least 50s'

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (endpoint) (increase(dashboard_backend_requests_by_client_total{job="dashboard_metrics", client=~"$client", endpoint=~"$endpoint", client="dashboard"}[$__range])) / sum by (endpoint) (increase(dashboard_backend_requests_by_client_total{job="dashboard_metrics", client=~"$client", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range]))

100 * sum by (endpoint) (increase(dashboard_backend_requests_by_client_total{job="dashboard_metrics", client=~"$client", endpoint=~"$endpoint", status_class=~"4xx|5xx"}[$__range])) / sum by (endpoint) (increase(dashboard_backend_requests_by_client_total{job="dashboard_metrics", client=~"$client", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (endpoint, le) (increase(dashboard_backend_request_latency_seconds_bucket{job="dashboard_metrics", client=~"$client", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (endpoint, le) (increase(dashboard_backend_request_latency_seconds_bucket{job="dashboard_metrics", client=~"$client", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range])))

sum by (endpoint) (increase(dashboard_backend_request_latency_seconds_sum{job="dashboard_metrics", client=~"$client", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range])) / sum by (endpoint) (increase(dashboard_backend_request_latency_seconds_count{job="dashboard_metrics", client=~"$client", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Top 10 endpoints by server time
panels.description: Seconds of request handling per second of wall time, per endpoint. 100% = one worker busy full time

panels.title: Daily unique visitors by endpoint
panels.description: Distinct visitors per endpoint per UTC day (salted and rotated daily, no IPs stored), top 10 endpoints. A visitor who uses several endpoints counts once in each, so the series do not add up to the daily total

panels.title: p95 latency, slowest 10 endpoints
panels.description: p95 over the whole dashboard time range, per endpoint. Endpoints with fewer than 20 requests in the range are left out: with a handful of requests the p95 is only a guess between two bucket edges. 75s means the p95 is above the largest finite bucket.

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (endpoint, le) (increase(dashboard_backend_request_latency_seconds_bucket{job="dashboard_metrics", client=~"$client", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range]))) and on (endpoint) (sum by (endpoint) (increase(dashboard_backend_request_latency_seconds_count{job="dashboard_metrics", client=~"$client", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range])) >= 20)))

panels.title: Slow requests
panels.description: Share of requests slower than 1s, 10s and 50s

panels.title: kci-dev requests by version
panels.description: Shows how quickly kci-dev users move to new releases

panels.title: Unknown clients: top endpoints
panels.description: Requests without a recognisable user agent: health checks, crawlers, prefetchers. Worth knowing when it dominates traffic

targets.expr: 60 * sum by (endpoint, status_class) (rate(dashboard_backend_requests_by_client_total{job="dashboard_metrics", client=~"$client", endpoint=~"$endpoint", status_class=~"4xx|5xx"}[$rate])) > 0

panels.title: Non-2xx responses by view (selected time range)
panels.description: From Django itself, so it includes requests outside /api/. '<unnamed view>' 404s are URLs that match no route, mostly scanners

panels.title: Database queries
panels.description: Only queries that go through the Django ORM cursor wrapper are counted
